svg.title: COGNAPSE Enterprise Research Pipeline Architecture
svg.desc: A single unified enterprise architecture diagram showing the complete COGNAPSE request lifecycle, AI orchestration, retrieval, verification, scoring, storage, rendering, sharing, and export systems.

g.text: ENTERPRISE RESEARCH PIPELINE / UNIFIED INTELLIGENCE INFRASTRUCTURE BLUEPRINT
ENTRY POINTS / USER INTENT / HUMAN ACTIONS
REACT CONTROL PLANE / STATE / REPORT UI / GRAPH UI
RETRIEVAL-FIRST PIPELINE / CACHE / FILTERING / SOURCE PREP
REMOTE KNOWLEDGE INDEXES / WEB SEARCH ADAPTERS
MODEL ROUTING / PARALLEL SWARM / FALLBACK CHAIN / DEEP BRANCH
DETERMINISTIC QUALITY CONTROL / CITATION / CONTRADICTION / CONFIDENCE
ENTITY EXTRACTION / CLUSTERS / RELATIONSHIPS / PHYSICSMAP PAYLOAD
FIREBASE / LOCAL CACHE / SNAPSHOTS / STACK / HISTORY
FINAL RENDERING / EXPORT / SHARING / RESPONSE DELIVERY
compact evidence payload for AI inference and scoring
cache hit returns directly; miss triggers external retrieval
Async Orchestration + Error Recovery + Timeout Guard
Weighted Quality Formula -> Credibility, Relevance, Consensus, Confidence Label, Risk Notes
persistence and hydration back to frontend
export and share lifecycle returns to user surface
